name: create_fastapi_tags_resource
description: Adds a new tags resource wired through schema, repository, router, and app
prompts: This FastAPI app (package `app`, with app/main.py, app/schemas.py, app/repository.py, and app/routers/users.py) already serves a users resource. Add a NEW tags resource, wiring it through every layer: (1) add TagCreate {name: str} and TagOut {id: int, name: str} models to app/schemas.py; (2) add a TagRepository to app/repository.py with add(name)->dict and list()->list, using its own auto-incrementing integer ids starting at 1; (3) create app/routers/tags.py with an APIRouter exposing POST /tags (201, body TagCreate, returns TagOut) and GET /tags (returns the list of TagOut); (4) include the tags router in app/main.py. Do not break the existing users endpoints.

setup_files.app/schemas.py:
from pydantic import BaseModel


class UserCreate(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str
    password: str


class UserOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str
    email: str
setup_files.app/main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.routers import users

app = FastAPI()
app.include_router(users.router)

test_setup_files.test_tags.py:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# new resource works end to end
r = client.post("/tags", json={"name": "urgent"})
assert r.status_code == 201, f"POST /tags: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
body = r.json()
assert body == {"id": 1, "name": "urgent"}, f"TagOut wrong: {body}"

r = client.post("/tags", json={"name": "later"})
assert r.json()["id"] == 2, "tag ids must auto-increment from 1"

r = client.get("/tags")
assert r.status_code == 200
names = [t["name"] for t in r.json()]
assert names == ["urgent", "later"], f"GET /tags wrong: {r.json()}"
# TagOut must not leak extra fields
assert set(r.json()[0].keys()) == {"id", "name"}, r.json()[0]

# existing users resource must still work
r = client.post("/users", json={"username": "ada", "email": "a@x.io", "password": "pw"})
assert r.status_code == 201, f"users endpoint broke: {r.status_code} {r.text}"
assert "password" not in r.json() and "password_hash" not in r.json()
print("PASS")
